prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally overly optimistic, though compact layouts and new audio flows outperformed expectations.
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) was helpful in 2 winning tests, though specific placements hurt or showed no clear effect.
Sign-in copy tweaks (sign_in, copy), new adoption flows (adoption, new_flow), and finish hints (finish, hint) showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Adding a new finish screen (finish, new_screen) either hurt performance or showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) were helpful in 1 winning test, while 4 tests showed no clear effect.
Evidence remains thin for any change kind tested only once, requiring at least 2 tests to state a rule.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Full Bleed Hero Redesign: Redesigns the story intro screen to a full-bleed visual layout with high-impact hero artwork introducing desktop pets. (why: Choose path screen has a mean time of 514s and 76.1% conversion. High-impact visual layouts set strong expectations early.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] Adoption Certificate Companion Audio Preview Screen: Adds a dedicated sound sample preview screen right after the adoption certificate stage where users hear their companion's voice. (why: Lessons show audio flows outperform expectations, and adoption is the main funnel bottleneck with only 62.1% conversion.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign In After Adoption Certificate: Moves the sign-in step directly after the adoption certificate screen, delaying account creation until commitment is complete. (why: Reordering sign-in later in the flow was effective in 2 winning tests, and adoption drops off significantly (62.1%).)
3: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Full Bleed Launch Redesign: Redesigns the final home intro screen with a full bleed layout giving prominent clarity on how to interact with the pet. (why: 3 support messages report confusion on controlling or hiding the pet, and finish step conversion is 71.4%.)
4: [home, hint] Waiting Screen Desktop Companion Loading Hint: Displays an explicit hint during generation explaining that the desktop companion app will pop up automatically when ready. (why: 3 support emails reported pets missing from desktop or app stalling before open, and home wait median time is 201s.)
5: [sign_in, layout] Sign In Screen Compact Card Layout: Converts the sign in screen to a compact layout that simplifies account registration options. (why: 8 support tickets cited reset or missing pets after signing in. Compact layouts have outperformed expectations in past tests.)
6: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Desktop Notification Alert: Enables desktop readiness notification toggle on the waiting screen while background generation processes. (why: Mean wait time on the waiting screen is 2336s, causing users to tab away and forget to return.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Choose Path Journey Clarification Copy: Updates headline and body text on choose_path screen to clearly contrast preset pets against custom photo generation. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet creation issues. Clear path differentiation reduces user confusion at 76.1% conversion.)
8: [adoption, new_flow] Pick Friend Compact Choice Card Flow: Rebuilds pet selection choices using rounded choice cards inside a compact layout. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest conversion in the funnel (62.1%) with high median completion time (89s). Compact layouts simplify choices.)
9: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Step Counter Indicator: Adds explicit step counter and progress display on the waiting screen during creation. (why: Home step wait time averages 2336s; clear step progress indicators reduce uncertainty during long waits.)
